title: Concept declaration (the graph: frontmatter of a Tier 1 concept skill)
description: The value of the single top-level graph: key in the YAML frontmatter of skills/concept/SKILL.md, as parsed to JSON. The key is present on every graph participant, and on a capability only when the capability declares graph fields. Exactly one branch of oneOf matches a valid declaration. The branch is chosen by role: phase, entry, refinement, observer, or no role at all for a capability. Each branch sets additionalProperties to false, so a field that does not apply to the role is rejected. Each branch requires graphSpecVersion. The schema does not check rules that need more than one document or a repository check, such as: each reference resolving, a refines target having a role the parent accepts, an after: cycle, the lifecycle of a deprecated concept, selection one for a phase or entry contract, a hand-off target having an input contract, or the match between this block and the Graph participation section. The compliance script checks those. References are qualified as <concept>@<marketplace>, except that when.node may use the bare concept name. The qualifier workspace is reserved for a consuming workspace's own concepts.

graphSpecVersion.description: The graph spec version this declaration is written to. Required whenever the graph: key is present.

interaction.description: Nodes only. Omitted means autonomous. Conversational is refused by the compliance script until the round trip is proven.

name.description: A bare concept name, or a bare alias, as used in aliases:.

qualifiedRef.description: A concept reference, <concept>@<marketplace>. The marketplace segment may be workspace for a consuming workspace's own concept.

nodeRef.description: The node named in a when: run fact. It may be the bare concept name or a qualified reference.

outcome.description: An outcome name, such as passed or failed.

edge.description: One outcome of a phase or entry, and the node the run goes to next. A terminal node omits edges.

uses.description: Qualified references to any concept, including a capability, used by name.

aliases.description: Former names that still resolve, with a warning.

after.description: Refinements and observers only. Qualified references to nodes this one orders after. A cycle is an error.

optional.description: Refinements and observers only. Default false. A workspace may switch an optional one off.

when.description: Refinements and observers only. Every key must hold. The keys node, path_exists and setting are reserved. Any other key is a call parameter, such as environment. Those keys are open by design, so additionalProperties is a value schema here instead of false. The compliance script checks the key names.

path_exists.description: A path relative to the repository root.

observes.description: Observers only. A phase or entry, all for every node in scope, or a role filter.

on.description: Observers only. Either concluded, or a list of outcomes that the observer fires on.

phase.description: A phase: a node that runs frame, support and conclude. It may have edges.

deprecated.description: The reason. Lifecycle is set by the owning marketplace only.

entry.description: An entry: a phase that starts its own chain. Its last node may hand off, so it may declare handoff:. Otherwise it is the same as a phase.

deprecated.description: The reason. Lifecycle is set by the owning marketplace only.

refinement.description: A refinement: a node that adds domain obligations to one parent. It has exactly one refines: target. It may have after, optional and when.

deprecated.description: The reason. Lifecycle is set by the owning marketplace only.

observer.description: An observer: a node that runs after another node concludes and cannot change its outcome. It declares what it observes and the outcomes it fires on.

deprecated.description: The reason. Lifecycle is set by the owning marketplace only.

capability.description: A capability: a concept with no role. It is not in the graph. It is used by name, and it may have no contract. It has no interaction, edges, refines, observes or on. A role key here is rejected by additionalProperties.

deprecated.description: The reason. Lifecycle is set by the owning marketplace only.
